description: A record for a TI id or an alias such as a CVE or GHSA id. Merged ids give the surviving record. By default the record is shortened: no CPE matches, at most 20 references (exploits and patches first) and the 10 newest advisories; trimmed says what was cut.

full.description: true: the whole record, as the REST API gives it, with every CPE match, reference and advisory

id.description: A Threatist id such as TI-2021-19919, or an alias such as CVE-2021-44228 or GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q

name: get_vulnerability
